microstep_order: settle due Gate B events in existing priority/sequence order
use right-continuous external rate and refresh current graph/routes/service under old kernel
validate selected exact batch from unchanged root
atomic Gate B multi-command commit, including due zero-time events
one graph/routes/service refresh after batch group

same_timestamp_tie.new_commands: canonical batch member order assigns deterministic reservations and event sequence
same_timestamp_tie.observation: right-continuous after prior physical/propagation events; no transient graph between commands of one atomic batch
same_timestamp_tie.economic: HOLD exact tie first; canonical joint proposal order otherwise

traffic.normalization: inherit D0 reference alpha_star/rho, no renormalization on K* or controller topology

drain.after240: Continue real physical/service drain, controller only at240,245,...,595 while unfinished>0.01; early completion ends run; no600 decision.
drain.at600: Settle real events at600, then COMPLETE if threshold met else CENSORED; no artificial clearing.
drain.ranking: Full-J contrast only if both COMPLETE; censored residual/delivery/time reported, no truncated-J ranking

horizon.cutoff_rule_status: REQUIRES_HUMAN_FREEZE; new v2 boundary rule, not inherited v1 equivalence
horizon.setup_completion: Actual ready<own window_end (<=600); required transition safety completion must be covered, otherwise horizon-limited rejection.
horizon.forecast: lambda_hat(t+s)=lambda(t), 0<=s<=H_eff; no actual next traffic phase read.
horizon.cross240: Retain simple persistence forecast even across a future arrival cutoff before t=240; at240 current observed lambda=0. Real trace always has zero input after240.
horizon.later_natural_expiry_after_transition_co: Not batch invalidity; real rollout/service sees consequences, reported separately.

network_state_updates: LINK_UP/DOWN/EXPIRE and service/propagation events occur at true timestamps, never delayed to5s controller epochs.
geometry_refresh: Inherit E2/P1 physical-event-driven route/delay refresh convention; changing controller cadence does not add periodic geometry refresh.
objective: J=sum_f integral (A_f-D_f) dt = sum_f integral (Q_f+I_f)dt; no switch/setup/outage hand penalty

future_policy.B1_B2_B3: current Q/I/current lambda/service/routes plus deterministic Gate C metadata; no forecast/actual future traffic
future_policy.B4: same physics plus root-local current-rate-persistence forecast; no future controller actions or actual future realization

fairness: same K*/initial states/geometry/trace/rho/capacity/scheduler/router/cadence/raw singles/joint pool/batch safety/drain and tolerances; branch identity per epoch and entire initial state across runs
provisional_policy: No global controller ranking; core contrast B4-v2 vs B3-v2, router-matched replay.
